column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C). Grease three 8- or 9-inch round pans, line with parchment and grease again.
Whisk the cake flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar on high for a full 5 minutes until fluffy. Add the oil and beat 1 minute.
Beat in the eggs, egg whites and vanilla on medium-high until combined.
Add the dry ingredients and buttermilk in three alternating additions, mixing just until incorporated. Gently fold in the sprinkles.
Spread the batter evenly among the pans.
Bake 25–26 minutes for 9-inch pans (27–28 for 8-inch), tenting with foil after 15 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pans 20 minutes, then turn out onto racks to cool completely.
For the frosting, beat the butter on medium 2 minutes. Add the powdered sugar, cream, vanilla and salt; beat on low 30 seconds then high 2 minutes, adjusting as needed.
Level the cakes. Stack with about 1 cup frosting between layers, then apply a thin crumb coat over the whole cake.
Chill at least 30 minutes, then cover with the remaining frosting and top with extra sprinkles if desired.
